body:
GREG, 2026-11-06 about 16:27Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #402, message e99bac4b), verbatim: „NIE ... PO TO MAMY SOURCE_ID ktory rozwiazuje te problemy wszyscy maja uzywac tylko source_id”.
Asistant's reading: every consumer judging source identity or state uses ONE shared source_id. No parallel fingerprints, no watcher-event dependencies, no .git hashing. This covers option B AND the launchers, gates and the general EO model.
At the time: the Windows Central PAUSE (Asistant #396) was in force; inventories only, no implementation.
JOINT INVENTORY (Engram #403 to Greg; TermAl via Asistant #578 plus addendum; agreed in Fable/Fable2 #6754–#6757):
- Engram (1): the launcher input fingerprint, new-untracked-only and the .git/info checks (scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs, test-launcher.mjs), referenced in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (the gate clause and test-ref names).
- Engram (2): the EO model stores TermAl turn observations whose source_revision may be content-v1.
- Engram (3): evaluations and `--source-fingerprint` compare source strings (evaluations OFF).
- Engram (4): review freeze by Git tree id; proposal: commits only.
- Engram watcher_only kind (docs/features/execution-observability.md). TermAl's source has no "watcher_only"; whether any sighting comes from watcher events is unknown.
- Engram (5): eo-cutover.mjs, unknown role.
- TermAl: (1) content-v1 is the default basis (ORDINARY_COMMIT_INPUT_DEFAULT false); (2) the host's own predicate copy; (3) the launcher's JS predicate copy; (4) its review-freeze fingerprint copy; (5) watcher fences on registered launcher runs; (6) the EO v12 watcher (being removed); (7) review-identity hashing; (8) EO turn observations carry content-v1 source_change (src/engram_source_observation_protocol.rs:126).
AGREED ORDER (for when Greg decides):
(a) TermAl 1+2+3+8 together with Engram 2: one source_id everywhere in turn observations and host checks.
(b) TermAl 5 together with Engram's watcher_only.
(c) TermAl 4+7 together with Engram 1 and 4, plus the instruction-text change in both repos (governance procedure).
Engram 3 at evaluation re-enable.
